scenario: LGRA.2.9.6.8 — an unknown binding in a `call … as` correlation string is a compile error (DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_BINDING), same as the other interpolation-eligible positions. Pin: `{nope}` references no LHS binding.
rules_ds:
service svc.do:
    kwarg line: String
    no response

schema Src scope logical:
    obj: String key

rule r:
    Src
->
    call svc.do line: "x" nocooldown as "rsvp-{nope}"
